parameters.query:
SELECT
    a.account_id,
    a.account_name,
    a.segment,
    a.account_tier,
    a.account_status,
    a.customer_since,
    a.sales_territory,

    s.sales_user_id AS owner_sales_user_id,
    s.name AS owner_name,
    s.role AS owner_role,
    s.territory AS owner_territory,
    s.status AS owner_status

FROM accounts a

LEFT JOIN sales_users s
    ON s.sales_user_id = a.account_owner_id

WHERE a.account_id = $1;
